command:
set -e; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PACKAGE=link.localclimate.app; test -x "$ADB"; DEVICES="$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | sed '/^$/d')"; test "$DEVICES" = "$SERIAL"; MODEL="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '')"; test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B" -o "$MODEL" = "SM_S906B"; DUMP="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '')"; printf '%s
' "$DUMP" | grep -q 'versionName=2.0.10'; printf '%s
' "$DUMP" | grep -q 'versionCode=20010'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PACKAGE"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PACKAGE/.MainActivity"; sleep 3; PID="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '')"; test -n "$PID"; ACT="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | tr -d '')"; printf '%s
' "$ACT" | grep -E 'topResumedActivity|mResumedActivity|ResumedActivity' | grep -m1 "$PACKAGE" >/dev/null || printf '%s
' "$ACT" | grep -m1 "$PACKAGE/.MainActivity" >/dev/null; if "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d --pid="$PID" -v brief | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime:.*FATAL|Process: link.localclimate.app.*has died'; then echo 'phone smoke found fatal process error' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo PHONE_SMOKE_PID=$PID MODEL=$MODEL VERSION=2.0.10 CODE=20010
